source.selection_scope: Replay excerpt only; original full benchmark denominator retained
source.command_alignment: Targets are issued at the recorded observation boundary. At the terminal row, the viewer carries forward the last issued target for reference; no new terminal command is invented. Targets are requested controller commands, not measured joint torque or fingertip force.

scope: Recorded authored, privileged-state rigid-block contact simulation. Native arm, gripper, table and free-object geometry reconstructed from full recorded qpos with mj_forward only. Success and failure labels are copied from the sealed benchmark; the viewer does not recompute them. No live physics, learned policy, shoe physics or physical robot qualification.
binary_pose_precision: little-endian Float32; positions meters, quaternions wxyz
